<style>
body {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
}
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.mm-container {
    max-width: 388px;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 32px 24px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid #D2D2D2;
    background: #FFF;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 48px;
    position: relative;
}

.close-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    background: #F0F0F0;
    position: absolute;
    top: 16px;
    right: 16px;
    padding: 10px;
    display: none;
}
.close-icon i{
    height: 10px;
    line-height: 10px;
    width: 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #000000;
}

.image-container img {
    margin: 0 auto !important;
    display: block;
}

.text-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 24px;
}

.text-heading {
    font-size: 25px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 32px;
    color: #191919;
}
.text-iconText-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 20px;
}
.iconText-container {
    margin-bottom: 0px !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px; 
}
.iconText-container i{
    height: 24px;
    line-height: 24px;
    width: 24px;
    font-size: 24px;
    color: #737373;
}
.iconText-desc {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 24px;
    color: #4C4C4C;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.MM-button {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: 44px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 20px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #6F10A2;
    border: 0px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: none;
    margin: 0 auto;
    margin-top: 4px;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 767px) {
    .mm-container {
        max-width: 100%;
        padding: 43px 20px 29px 20px;
        border: 0px;
        border-radius: 20px 20px 0px 0px;
    }
    .MM-button {
        display: block;
    }
    .close-icon {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
    }
}
</style>

PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_2: The Privacy Policy Statement will help you understand how we collect, use and protect your information when you visit our site. PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_3: This policy should be read in conjunction with the Terms and Conditions section of this site.
PrivacyPolicy.PILLAR_ONE_PARA: The security of all information associated with our customers is an important concern to us. Therefore, at www.daralarkan.com, we exercise the utmost care in providing secure transmission of your information from your own device to our servers. As known, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your information, Dar Al Arkan cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us, or from our online products or services, and you do so at your risk. Once we receive your transmission, Dar Al Arkan uses industry standard efforts to safeguard the confidentiality of your information. However, “perfect security” does not exist on the Internet as known.
PrivacyPolicy.PILLAR_TWO_PARA: The general rule is that Dar Al Arkan will not disclose any information that you submit to us (especially your personal information), in a manner that it would link to your identity, except, when we have your explicit permission to disclose it, or under special circumstances, such as when we believe in good faith, that the law requires it.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PARA_ONE: By using this site, you agree with the Dar Al Arkan Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use this site, and your continued use of Dar Al Arkan website will mean you accept this Privacy Policy. Information:

PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_ONE: Registering emails: Information about Dar Al Arkan, new projects, products and services will be sent periodically through newsletters, updating customers about the latest developments.

<style>
body {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
}
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.mm-container {
    max-width: 388px;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 32px 24px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid #D2D2D2;
    background: #FFF;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 48px;
    position: relative;
}

.close-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    background: #F0F0F0;
    position: absolute;
    top: 16px;
    right: 16px;
    padding: 10px;
    display: none;
}
.close-icon i{
    height: 10px;
    line-height: 10px;
    width: 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #000000;
}

.image-container img {
    margin: 0 auto !important;
    display: block;
}

.text-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 24px;
}

.text-heading {
    font-size: 25px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 32px;
    color: #191919;
}
.text-iconText-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 20px;
}
.iconText-container {
    margin-bottom: 0px !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px; 
}
.iconText-container i{
    height: 24px;
    line-height: 24px;
    width: 24px;
    font-size: 24px;
    color: #737373;
}
.iconText-desc {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 24px;
    color: #4C4C4C;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.MM-button {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: 44px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 20px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #6F10A2;
    border: 0px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: none;
    margin: 0 auto;
    margin-top: 4px;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 767px) {
    .mm-container {
        max-width: 100%;
        padding: 43px 20px 29px 20px;
        border: 0px;
        border-radius: 20px 20px 0px 0px;
    }
    .MM-button {
        display: block;
    }
    .close-icon {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
    }
}
</style>

Terms.t1: The  Advertising  Terms  are  the  legal  document  that  defines  the  rights  and obligations  between  you  and  Wasalt  Real  Estate  Services  Company,  and should be read along with the Terms of Use, the Privacy Policy and any other terms and conditions posted on the website.
Terms.t2: By entering this page and advertising on the website; as an Advertiser, you acknowledge and agree to be bound by the following:
Terms.t4: To  comply  with  what  is  issued  by  the  general  guide  for  the  controls  of advertising content.
Terms.t5: To abide by what is issued by the competent authorities to regulate ethical and   media   content   in   all   its   informational   media   (traditional   and electronic).
Terms.t6: To abide by the official names of cities, neighborhoods, streets and types of real estate, it is permissible to add customary names
Terms.t7: The Advertisement must contain the following information:
Terms.t8: It  is  stated  as  an  advertisement  (this  can  be  mentioned  in  the description)
Terms.t9: Purpose of the advertisement is specified (sale, rent, etc.)
Terms.t11: The advertiser's name and capacity (owner, authorized)
Terms.t12: The  advertiser's  license  number  is  mentioned  if  he  is  an  office,  a real estate marketer, or holds a freelance document
Terms.t13: Location of the property is mentioned, provided that it contains - at a minimum - the city - the neighborhood - the plot number, if any
Terms.t14: An   effective   means   of   communication   with   the   advertiser   is mentioned
Terms.t15: Real estate data is disclosed as follows:
Terms.t18: - Mortgage or restriction that prevents or limits the disposal or use of real estate
Terms.t19: - Rights and obligations over the property that is not stipulated in the property documents (in the event of a written agreement not mentioned in the deed, for example)
Terms.t21: - Information   that   may   affect   the   property,   whether   by decreasing  its  value  or  affecting  the  target’s  decision  to advertise,  such  as  guarantees  and  their  duration,  matching the Saudi building code, the age of the existing property, and so on.
Terms.t22: - If the Advertisement is a real estate auction, it must - in addition to what is issued by the relevant authorities - include the auction license number, place and conditions, the exact date of its holding, its duration, and the deadline - if any - for submitting to the auction.
Terms.t23: - Description of the property, including its type, age, contents, and any effective description such as the width of the street on which it is located, the facade of the property, and others
Terms.t24: - Limits and lengths of the property
Terms.t26: Any of the following shall be prohibited to be included in the real estate advertisement:
Terms.t27: Violation of Islamic instructions, regulations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, or prevailing customs
Terms.t30: Negative exposure to competitors, private sector establishments, or others
Terms.t31: Phrases or signs that discriminate against anyone
Terms.t32: Pictures, data, website, or perspectives that are misleading or not related to the advertised property
Terms.t33: Logo or name of the Real Estate General Authority or any other government agency without their prior permission
Terms.t34: Publishing fake real estate ads for the purpose of collecting data from recipients or the public or any other purpose is prohibited
Terms.t35: The website shall be entitled to delete any advertisement without stating the reason for the deletion
Terms.t36: The advertiser declares that he is authorized and/or legally authorized to do the advertisement.
Terms.t37: The advertiser agrees to pay the advertising fees to the company (Wasalt Real Estate Services Company), upon executing any sale or rent deals to any client who have reached the advertiser/advertised property by using or visiting the website. The advertiser also agrees that the customer's statement in this regard is final and he is obligated to pay the advertising fees.
Terms.t38: To avoid anything that causes confusion or mislead the public.

PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_1: Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company (hereinafter referred to as “Dar Al Arkan” “us” “we” or “our”) is committed, to respecting your privacy and complying with applicable data protection and privacy laws. You can visit
PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_2: The Privacy Policy Statement will help you understand how we collect, use and protect your information when you visit our site. We would also like to help you make informed decisions based on accurate and clear information, so please read the following to learn how we may use your personal information.
PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_3: This policy should be read in conjunction with the Terms and Conditions section of this site.
PrivacyPolicy.PILLAR_ONE_PARA: The security of all information associated with our customers is an important concern to us. Therefore, at www.daralarkan.com, we exercise the utmost care in providing secure transmission of your information from your own device to our servers. As known, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your information, Dar Al Arkan cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us, or from our online products or services, and you do so at your risk. Once we receive your transmission, Dar Al Arkan uses industry standard efforts to safeguard the confidentiality of your information. However, “perfect security” does not exist on the Internet as known.
PrivacyPolicy.PILLAR_TWO_PARA: The general rule is that Dar Al Arkan will not disclose any information that you submit to us (especially your personal information), in a manner that it would link to your identity, except, when we have your explicit permission to disclose it, or under special circumstances, such as when we believe in good faith, that the law requires it.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PARA_ONE: By using this site, you agree with the Dar Al Arkan Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use this site, and your continued use of Dar Al Arkan website will mean you accept this Privacy Policy. Information:
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PARA_TWO: The following forms available on the site (www.daralarkan.com) collect your personal data:
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_ONE: Registering emails: Information about Dar Al Arkan, new projects, products and services will be sent periodically through newsletters, updating customers about the latest developments.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_TWO: Contact Us: The information provided by the customer through the contact tab, will not be stored by www.daralarkan.com, and will be used solely to respond to customer inquiries or service requests.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_FOUR: Credit information: Information about the credit policy of Dar Al Arkan will be provided to the customer upon the request, and your credit-information will be kept confidential.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_THREE: Residential Unit Reservation Form: The information provided in this form will be used only to reserve the concerned apartment upon customer request.

matchmakeronboardingbanner.head_rawhtml:
<style>
body {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
}
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.mm-container {
    max-width: 388px;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 32px 24px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid #D2D2D2;
    background: #FFF;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 48px;
    position: relative;
}

.close-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    background: #F0F0F0;
    position: absolute;
    top: 16px;
    right: 16px;
    padding: 10px;
    display: none;
}
.close-icon i{
    height: 10px;
    line-height: 10px;
    width: 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #000000;
}

.image-container img {
    margin: 0 auto !important;
    display: block;
}

.text-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 24px;
}

.text-heading {
    font-size: 25px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 32px;
    color: #191919;
}
.text-iconText-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 20px;
}
.iconText-container {
    margin-bottom: 0px !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px; 
}
.iconText-container i{
    height: 24px;
    line-height: 24px;
    width: 24px;
    font-size: 24px;
    color: #737373;
}
.iconText-desc {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 24px;
    color: #4C4C4C;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.MM-button {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: 44px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 20px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #6F10A2;
    border: 0px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: none;
    margin: 0 auto;
    margin-top: 4px;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 767px) {
    .mm-container {
        max-width: 100%;
        padding: 43px 20px 29px 20px;
        border: 0px;
        border-radius: 20px 20px 0px 0px;
    }
    .MM-button {
        display: block;
    }
    .close-icon {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
    }
}
</style>
<script src="https://cms.wasalt.com/uploads/matchmaker_onboarding_8f9d1ee01b.js"></script>

Terms.t2: By entering this page and advertising on the website; as an Advertiser, you acknowledge and agree to be bound by the following:
Terms.t4: To  comply  with  what  is  issued  by  the  general  guide  for  the  controls  of advertising content.
Terms.t5: To abide by what is issued by the competent authorities to regulate ethical and   media   content   in   all   its   informational   media   (traditional   and electronic).
Terms.t6: To abide by the official names of cities, neighborhoods, streets and types of real estate, it is permissible to add customary names
Terms.t7: The Advertisement must contain the following information:
Terms.t8: It  is  stated  as  an  advertisement  (this  can  be  mentioned  in  the description)
Terms.t9: Purpose of the advertisement is specified (sale, rent, etc.)
Terms.t11: The advertiser's name and capacity (owner, authorized)
Terms.t12: The  advertiser's  license  number  is  mentioned  if  he  is  an  office,  a real estate marketer, or holds a freelance document
Terms.t13: Location of the property is mentioned, provided that it contains - at a minimum - the city - the neighborhood - the plot number, if any
Terms.t14: An   effective   means   of   communication   with   the   advertiser   is mentioned
Terms.t15: Real estate data is disclosed as follows:
Terms.t18: - Mortgage or restriction that prevents or limits the disposal or use of real estate
Terms.t19: - Rights and obligations over the property that is not stipulated in the property documents (in the event of a written agreement not mentioned in the deed, for example)
Terms.t21: - Information   that   may   affect   the   property,   whether   by decreasing  its  value  or  affecting  the  target’s  decision  to advertise,  such  as  guarantees  and  their  duration,  matching the Saudi building code, the age of the existing property, and so on.
Terms.t22: - If the Advertisement is a real estate auction, it must - in addition to what is issued by the relevant authorities - include the auction license number, place and conditions, the exact date of its holding, its duration, and the deadline - if any - for submitting to the auction.
Terms.t23: - Description of the property, including its type, age, contents, and any effective description such as the width of the street on which it is located, the facade of the property, and others
Terms.t24: - Limits and lengths of the property
Terms.t26: Any of the following shall be prohibited to be included in the real estate advertisement:
Terms.t27: Violation of Islamic instructions, regulations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, or prevailing customs
Terms.t30: Negative exposure to competitors, private sector establishments, or others
Terms.t31: Phrases or signs that discriminate against anyone
Terms.t32: Pictures, data, website, or perspectives that are misleading or not related to the advertised property
Terms.t33: Logo or name of the Real Estate General Authority or any other government agency without their prior permission
Terms.t34: Publishing fake real estate ads for the purpose of collecting data from recipients or the public or any other purpose is prohibited
Terms.t35: The website shall be entitled to delete any advertisement without stating the reason for the deletion
Terms.t36: The advertiser declares that he is authorized and/or legally authorized to do the advertisement.
Terms.t37: The advertiser agrees to pay the advertising fees to the company (Wasalt Real Estate Services Company), upon executing any sale or rent deals to any client who have reached the advertiser/advertised property by using or visiting the website. Therefore, at www.daralarkan.com, we exercise the utmost care in providing secure transmission of your information from your own device to our servers. As known, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your information, Dar Al Arkan cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us, or from our online products or services, and you do so at your risk. Once we receive your transmission, Dar Al Arkan uses industry standard efforts to safeguard the confidentiality of your information. However, “perfect security” does not exist on the Internet as known.

<style>
body {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
}
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.mm-container {
    max-width: 388px;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 32px 24px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid #D2D2D2;
    background: #FFF;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 48px;
    position: relative;
}

.close-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    background: #F0F0F0;
    position: absolute;
    top: 16px;
    right: 16px;
    padding: 10px;
    display: none;
}
.close-icon i{
    height: 10px;
    line-height: 10px;
    width: 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #000000;
}

.image-container img {
    margin: 0 auto !important;
    display: block;
}

.text-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 24px;
}

.text-heading {
    font-size: 25px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 32px;
    color: #191919;
}
.text-iconText-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 20px;
}
.iconText-container {
    margin-bottom: 0px !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px; 
}
.iconText-container i{
    height: 24px;
    line-height: 24px;
    width: 24px;
    font-size: 24px;
    color: #737373;
}
.iconText-desc {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 24px;
    color: #4C4C4C;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.MM-button {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: 44px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 20px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #6F10A2;
    border: 0px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: none;
    margin: 0 auto;
    margin-top: 4px;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 767px) {
    .mm-container {
        max-width: 100%;
        padding: 43px 20px 29px 20px;
        border: 0px;
        border-radius: 20px 20px 0px 0px;
    }
    .MM-button {
        display: block;
    }
    .close-icon {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
    }
}
</style>

PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_1: Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company (hereinafter referred to as “Dar Al Arkan” “us” “we” or “our”) is committed, to respecting your privacy and complying with applicable data protection and privacy laws. You can visit
PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_2: The Privacy Policy Statement will help you understand how we collect, use and protect your information when you visit our site. We would also like to help you make informed decisions based on accurate and clear information, so please read the following to learn how we may use your personal information.
PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_3: This policy should be read in conjunction with the Terms and Conditions section of this site.
PrivacyPolicy.PILLAR_ONE_PARA: The security of all information associated with our customers is an important concern to us. Therefore, at www.daralarkan.com, we exercise the utmost care in providing secure transmission of your information from your own device to our servers. As known, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your information, Dar Al Arkan cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us, or from our online products or services, and you do so at your risk. Once we receive your transmission, Dar Al Arkan uses industry standard efforts to safeguard the confidentiality of your information. However, “perfect security” does not exist on the Internet as known.
PrivacyPolicy.PILLAR_TWO_PARA: The general rule is that Dar Al Arkan will not disclose any information that you submit to us (especially your personal information), in a manner that it would link to your identity, except, when we have your explicit permission to disclose it, or under special circumstances, such as when we believe in good faith, that the law requires it.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PARA_ONE: By using this site, you agree with the Dar Al Arkan Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use this site, and your continued use of Dar Al Arkan website will mean you accept this Privacy Policy. Information:
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PARA_TWO: The following forms available on the site (www.daralarkan.com) collect your personal data:
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_ONE: Registering emails: Information about Dar Al Arkan, new projects, products and services will be sent periodically through newsletters, updating customers about the latest developments.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_TWO: Contact Us: The information provided by the customer through the contact tab, will not be stored by www.daralarkan.com, and will be used solely to respond to customer inquiries or service requests.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_FOUR: Credit information: Information about the credit policy of Dar Al Arkan will be provided to the customer upon the request, and your credit-information will be kept confidential.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_THREE: Residential Unit Reservation Form: The information provided in this form will be used only to reserve the concerned apartment upon customer request.

<style>
body {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
}
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.mm-container {
    max-width: 388px;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 32px 24px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid #D2D2D2;
    background: #FFF;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 48px;
    position: relative;
}

.close-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    background: #F0F0F0;
    position: absolute;
    top: 16px;
    right: 16px;
    padding: 10px;
    display: none;

PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_1: Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company (hereinafter referred to as “Dar Al Arkan” “us” “we” or “our”) is committed, to respecting your privacy and complying with applicable data protection and privacy laws. You can visit
PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_2: The Privacy Policy Statement will help you understand how we collect, use and protect your information when you visit our site. We would also like to help you make informed decisions based on accurate and clear information, so please read the following to learn how we may use your personal information.
PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_3: This policy should be read in conjunction with the Terms and Conditions section of this site.
PrivacyPolicy.PILLAR_ONE_PARA: The security of all information associated with our customers is an important concern to us. Therefore, at www.daralarkan.com, we exercise the utmost care in providing secure transmission of your information from your own device to our servers. As known, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your information, Dar Al Arkan cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us, or from our online products or services, and you do so at your risk. Once we receive your transmission, Dar Al Arkan uses industry standard efforts to safeguard the confidentiality of your information. However, “perfect security” does not exist on the Internet as known.
PrivacyPolicy.PILLAR_TWO_PARA: The general rule is that Dar Al Arkan will not disclose any information that you submit to us (especially your personal information), in a manner that it would link to your identity, except, when we have your explicit permission to disclose it, or under special circumstances, such as when we believe in good faith, that the law requires it.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PARA_ONE: By using this site, you agree with the Dar Al Arkan Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use this site, and your continued use of Dar Al Arkan website will mean you accept this Privacy Policy. Information:
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PARA_TWO: The following forms available on the site (www.daralarkan.com) collect your personal data:
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_ONE: Registering emails: Information about Dar Al Arkan, new projects, products and services will be sent periodically through newsletters, updating customers about the latest developments.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_TWO: Contact Us: The information provided by the customer through the contact tab, will not be stored by www.daralarkan.com, and will be used solely to respond to customer inquiries or service requests.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_FOUR: Credit information: Information about the credit policy of Dar Al Arkan will be provided to the customer upon the request, and your credit-information will be kept confidential.

<style>
body {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
}
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.mm-container {
    max-width: 388px;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 32px 24px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid #D2D2D2;
    background: #FFF;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 48px;
    position: relative;
}

.close-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    background: #F0F0F0;
    position: absolute;
    top: 16px;
    right: 16px;
    padding: 10px;
    display: none;
}
.close-icon i{
    height: 10px;
    line-height: 10px;
    width: 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #000000;
}

.image-container img {
    margin: 0 auto !important;
    display: block;
}

.text-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 24px;
}

.text-heading {
    font-size: 25px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 32px;
    color: #191919;
}
.text-iconText-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 20px;
}
.iconText-container {
    margin-bottom: 0px !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px; 
}
.iconText-container i{
    height: 24px;
    line-height: 24px;
    width: 24px;
    font-size: 24px;
    color: #737373;
}
.iconText-desc {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 24px;
    color: #4C4C4C;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.MM-button {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: 44px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 20px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #6F10A2;
    border: 0px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: none;
    margin: 0 auto;
    margin-top: 4px;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 767px) {
    .mm-container {
        max-width: 100%;
        padding: 43px 20px 29px 20px;
        border: 0px;
        border-radius: 20px 20px 0px 0px;
    }
    .MM-button {
        display: block;
    }
    .close-icon {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
    }
}
</style>

Terms.t23: - Description of the property, including its type, age, contents, and any effective description such as the width of the street on which it is located, the facade of the property, and others

Terms.t27: Violation of Islamic instructions, regulations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, or prevailing customs

Terms.t31: Phrases or signs that discriminate against anyone
Terms.t32: Pictures, data, website, or perspectives that are misleading or not related to the advertised property
Terms.t33: Logo or name of the Real Estate General Authority or any other government agency without their prior permission
Terms.t34: Publishing fake real estate ads for the purpose of collecting data from recipients or the public or any other purpose is prohibited
Terms.t35: The website shall be entitled to delete any advertisement without stating the reason for the deletion
Terms.t36: The advertiser declares that he is authorized and/or legally authorized to do the advertisement.
Terms.t37: The advertiser agrees to pay the advertising fees to the company (Wasalt Real Estate Services Company), upon executing any sale or rent deals to any client who have reached the advertiser/advertised property by using or visiting the website. PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_1: Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company (hereinafter referred to as “Dar Al Arkan” “us” “we” or “our”) is committed, to respecting your privacy and complying with applicable data protection and privacy laws. You can visit
PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_2: The Privacy Policy Statement will help you understand how we collect, use and protect your information when you visit our site. We would also like to help you make informed decisions based on accurate and clear information, so please read the following to learn how we may use your personal information.
PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_3: This policy should be read in conjunction with the Terms and Conditions section of this site.
PrivacyPolicy.PILLAR_ONE_PARA: The security of all information associated with our customers is an important concern to us. Therefore, at www.daralarkan.com, we exercise the utmost care in providing secure transmission of your information from your own device to our servers. As known, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your information, Dar Al Arkan cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us, or from our online products or services, and you do so at your risk. Once we receive your transmission, Dar Al Arkan uses industry standard efforts to safeguard the confidentiality of your information. However, “perfect security” does not exist on the Internet as known.
PrivacyPolicy.PILLAR_TWO_PARA: The general rule is that Dar Al Arkan will not disclose any information that you submit to us (especially your personal information), in a manner that it would link to your identity, except, when we have your explicit permission to disclose it, or under special circumstances, such as when we believe in good faith, that the law requires it.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PARA_ONE: By using this site, you agree with the Dar Al Arkan Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use this site, and your continued use of Dar Al Arkan website will mean you accept this Privacy Policy. Information:
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PARA_TWO: The following forms available on the site (www.daralarkan.com) collect your personal data:
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_ONE: Registering emails: Information about Dar Al Arkan, new projects, products and services will be sent periodically through newsletters, updating customers about the latest developments.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_TWO: Contact Us: The information provided by the customer through the contact tab, will not be stored by www.daralarkan.com, and will be used solely to respond to customer inquiries or service requests.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_FOUR: Credit information: Information about the credit policy of Dar Al Arkan will be provided to the customer upon the request, and your credit-information will be kept confidential.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_THREE: Residential Unit Reservation Form: The information provided in this form will be used only to reserve the concerned apartment upon customer request.

matchmakeronboardingbanner.head_rawhtml:
<style>
body {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
}
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.mm-container {
    max-width: 388px;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 32px 24px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid #D2D2D2;
    background: #FFF;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 48px;
    position: relative;
}

.close-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    background: #F0F0F0;
    position: absolute;
    top: 16px;
    right: 16px;
    padding: 10px;
    display: none;
}
.close-icon i{
    height: 10px;
    line-height: 10px;
    width: 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #000000;
}

.image-container img {
    margin: 0 auto !important;
    display: block;
}

.text-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 24px;
}

.text-heading {
    font-size: 25px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 32px;
    color: #191919;
}
.text-iconText-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 20px;
}
.iconText-container {
    margin-bottom: 0px !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px; 
}
.iconText-container i{
    height: 24px;
    line-height: 24px;
    width: 24px;
    font-size: 24px;
    color: #737373;
}
.iconText-desc {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 24px;
    color: #4C4C4C;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.MM-button {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: 44px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 20px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #6F10A2;
    border: 0px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: none;
    margin: 0 auto;
    margin-top: 4px;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 767px) {
    .mm-container {
        max-width: 100%;
        padding: 43px 20px 29px 20px;
        border: 0px;
        border-radius: 20px 20px 0px 0px;
    }
    .MM-button {
        display: block;
    }
    .close-icon {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
    }
}
</style>
<script src="https://cms.wasalt.com/uploads/matchmaker_onboarding_8f9d1ee01b.js"></script>

Terms.t9: Purpose of the advertisement is specified (sale, rent, etc.)
Terms.t11: The advertiser's name and capacity (owner, authorized)

<style>
body {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
}
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.mm-container {
    max-width: 388px;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 32px 24px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid #D2D2D2;
    background: #FFF;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 48px;
    position: relative;
}

.close-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    background: #F0F0F0;
    position: absolute;
    top: 16px;
    right: 16px;
    padding: 10px;
    display: none;
}
.close-icon i{
    height: 10px;
    line-height: 10px;
    width: 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #000000;
}

.image-container img {
    margin: 0 auto !important;
    display: block;
}

.text-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 24px;
}

.text-heading {
    font-size: 25px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 32px;
    color: #191919;
}
.text-iconText-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 20px;
}
.iconText-container {
    margin-bottom: 0px !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px; 
}
.iconText-container i{
    height: 24px;
    line-height: 24px;
    width: 24px;
    font-size: 24px;
    color: #737373;
}
.iconText-desc {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 24px;
    color: #4C4C4C;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.MM-button {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: 44px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 20px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #6F10A2;
    border: 0px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: none;
    margin: 0 auto;
    margin-top: 4px;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 767px) {
    .mm-container {
        max-width: 100%;
        padding: 43px 20px 29px 20px;
        border: 0px;
        border-radius: 20px 20px 0px 0px;
    }
    .MM-button {
        display: block;
    }
    .close-icon {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
    }
}
</style>

PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_2: The Privacy Policy Statement will help you understand how we collect, use and protect your information when you visit our site. PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_3: This policy should be read in conjunction with the Terms and Conditions section of this site.
PrivacyPolicy.PILLAR_ONE_PARA: The security of all information associated with our customers is an important concern to us. Therefore, at www.daralarkan.com, we exercise the utmost care in providing secure transmission of your information from your own device to our servers. As known, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your information, Dar Al Arkan cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us, or from our online products or services, and you do so at your risk. Once we receive your transmission, Dar Al Arkan uses industry standard efforts to safeguard the confidentiality of your information. However, “perfect security” does not exist on the Internet as known.
PrivacyPolicy.PILLAR_TWO_PARA: The general rule is that Dar Al Arkan will not disclose any information that you submit to us (especially your personal information), in a manner that it would link to your identity, except, when we have your explicit permission to disclose it, or under special circumstances, such as when we believe in good faith, that the law requires it.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PARA_ONE: By using this site, you agree with the Dar Al Arkan Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use this site, and your continued use of Dar Al Arkan website will mean you accept this Privacy Policy. Information:
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PARA_TWO: The following forms available on the site (www.daralarkan.com) collect your personal data:
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_ONE: Registering emails: Information about Dar Al Arkan, new projects, products and services will be sent periodically through newsletters, updating customers about the latest developments.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_TWO: Contact Us: The information provided by the customer through the contact tab, will not be stored by www.daralarkan.com, and will be used solely to respond to customer inquiries or service requests.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_FOUR: Credit information: Information about the credit policy of Dar Al Arkan will be provided to the customer upon the request, and your credit-information will be kept confidential.

<style>
body {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
}
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.mm-container {
    max-width: 388px;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 32px 24px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid #D2D2D2;
    background: #FFF;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 48px;
    position: relative;
}

.close-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    background: #F0F0F0;
    position: absolute;
    top: 16px;
    right: 16px;
    padding: 10px;
    display: none;
}
.close-icon i{
    height: 10px;
    line-height: 10px;
    width: 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #000000;
}

.image-container img {
    margin: 0 auto !important;
    display: block;
}

.text-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 24px;
}

.text-heading {
    font-size: 25px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 32px;
    color: #191919;
}
.text-iconText-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 20px;
}
.iconText-container {
    margin-bottom: 0px !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px; 
}
.iconText-container i{
    height: 24px;
    line-height: 24px;
    width: 24px;
    font-size: 24px;
    color: #737373;
}
.iconText-desc {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 24px;
    color: #4C4C4C;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.MM-button {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: 44px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 20px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #6F10A2;
    border: 0px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: none;
    margin: 0 auto;
    margin-top: 4px;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 767px) {
    .mm-container {
        max-width: 100%;
        padding: 43px 20px 29px 20px;
        border: 0px;
        border-radius: 20px 20px 0px 0px;
    }
    .MM-button {
        display: block;
    }
    .close-icon {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
    }
}
</style>

PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_2: The Privacy Policy Statement will help you understand how we collect, use and protect your information when you visit our site. We would also like to help you make informed decisions based on accurate and clear information, so please read the following to learn how we may use your personal information.
PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_3: This policy should be read in conjunction with the Terms and Conditions section of this site.
PrivacyPolicy.PILLAR_ONE_PARA: The security of all information associated with our customers is an important concern to us. Therefore, at www.daralarkan.com, we exercise the utmost care in providing secure transmission of your information from your own device to our servers. As known, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your information, Dar Al Arkan cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us, or from our online products or services, and you do so at your risk. Once we receive your transmission, Dar Al Arkan uses industry standard efforts to safeguard the confidentiality of your information. However, “perfect security” does not exist on the Internet as known.
PrivacyPolicy.PILLAR_TWO_PARA: The general rule is that Dar Al Arkan will not disclose any information that you submit to us (especially your personal information), in a manner that it would link to your identity, except, when we have your explicit permission to disclose it, or under special circumstances, such as when we believe in good faith, that the law requires it.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PARA_ONE: By using this site, you agree with the Dar Al Arkan Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use this site, and your continued use of Dar Al Arkan website will mean you accept this Privacy Policy. Information:

PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_ONE: Registering emails: Information about Dar Al Arkan, new projects, products and services will be sent periodically through newsletters, updating customers about the latest developments.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_TWO: Contact Us: The information provided by the customer through the contact tab, will not be stored by www.daralarkan.com, and will be used solely to respond to customer inquiries or service requests.

matchmakeronboardingbanner.head_rawhtml:
<style>
body {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
}
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.mm-container {
    max-width: 388px;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 32px 24px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid #D2D2D2;
    background: #FFF;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 48px;
    position: relative;
}

.close-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    background: #F0F0F0;
    position: absolute;
    top: 16px;
    right: 16px;
    padding: 10px;
    display: none;
}
.close-icon i{
    height: 10px;
    line-height: 10px;
    width: 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #000000;
}

.image-container img {
    margin: 0 auto !important;
    display: block;
}

.text-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 24px;
}

.text-heading {
    font-size: 25px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 32px;
    color: #191919;
}
.text-iconText-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 20px;
}
.iconText-container {
    margin-bottom: 0px !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px; 
}
.iconText-container i{
    height: 24px;
    line-height: 24px;
    width: 24px;
    font-size: 24px;
    color: #737373;
}
.iconText-desc {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 24px;
    color: #4C4C4C;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.MM-button {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: 44px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 20px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #6F10A2;
    border: 0px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: none;
    margin: 0 auto;
    margin-top: 4px;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 767px) {
    .mm-container {
        max-width: 100%;
        padding: 43px 20px 29px 20px;
        border: 0px;
        border-radius: 20px 20px 0px 0px;
    }
    .MM-button {
        display: block;
    }
    .close-icon {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
    }
}
</style>
<script src="https://cms.wasalt.com/uploads/matchmaker_onboarding_8f9d1ee01b.js"></script>

Terms.t4: To  comply  with  what  is  issued  by  the  general  guide  for  the  controls  of advertising content.
Terms.t5: To abide by what is issued by the competent authorities to regulate ethical and   media   content   in   all   its   informational   media   (traditional   and electronic).
Terms.t6: To abide by the official names of cities, neighborhoods, streets and types of real estate, it is permissible to add customary names
Terms.t7: The Advertisement must contain the following information:
Terms.t8: It  is  stated  as  an  advertisement  (this  can  be  mentioned  in  the description)
Terms.t9: Purpose of the advertisement is specified (sale, rent, etc.)
Terms.t11: The advertiser's name and capacity (owner, authorized)
Terms.t12: The  advertiser's  license  number  is  mentioned  if  he  is  an  office,  a real estate marketer, or holds a freelance document
Terms.t13: Location of the property is mentioned, provided that it contains - at a minimum - the city - the neighborhood - the plot number, if any
Terms.t14: An   effective   means   of   communication   with   the   advertiser   is mentioned
Terms.t15: Real estate data is disclosed as follows:
Terms.t18: - Mortgage or restriction that prevents or limits the disposal or use of real estate
Terms.t19: - Rights and obligations over the property that is not stipulated in the property documents (in the event of a written agreement not mentioned in the deed, for example)
Terms.t21: - Information   that   may   affect   the   property,   whether   by decreasing  its  value  or  affecting  the  target’s  decision  to advertise,  such  as  guarantees  and  their  duration,  matching the Saudi building code, the age of the existing property, and so on.
Terms.t22: - If the Advertisement is a real estate auction, it must - in addition to what is issued by the relevant authorities - include the auction license number, place and conditions, the exact date of its holding, its duration, and the deadline - if any - for submitting to the auction.
Terms.t23: - Description of the property, including its type, age, contents, and any effective description such as the width of the street on which it is located, the facade of the property, and others
Terms.t24: - Limits and lengths of the property
Terms.t26: Any of the following shall be prohibited to be included in the real estate advertisement:
Terms.t27: Violation of Islamic instructions, regulations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, or prevailing customs
Terms.t30: Negative exposure to competitors, private sector establishments, or others
Terms.t31: Phrases or signs that discriminate against anyone
Terms.t32: Pictures, data, website, or perspectives that are misleading or not related to the advertised property
Terms.t33: Logo or name of the Real Estate General Authority or any other government agency without their prior permission
Terms.t34: Publishing fake real estate ads for the purpose of collecting data from recipients or the public or any other purpose is prohibited
Terms.t35: The website shall be entitled to delete any advertisement without stating the reason for the deletion
Terms.t36: The advertiser declares that he is authorized and/or legally authorized to do the advertisement.

As a result, while we strive to protect your information, Dar Al Arkan cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us, or from our online products or services, and you do so at your risk. Once we receive your transmission, Dar Al Arkan uses industry standard efforts to safeguard the confidentiality of your information. However, “perfect security” does not exist on the Internet as known.

body {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
}
* {

    padding: 0;

}

.mm-container {

    background: #FFF;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 48px;
    position: relative;
}

.close-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    background: #F0F0F0;
    position: absolute;
    top: 16px;
    right: 16px;
    padding: 10px;
    display: none;
}
.close-icon i{
    height: 10px;
    line-height: 10px;
    width: 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #000000;
}

.image-container img {
    margin: 0 auto !important;
    display: block;
}

.text-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 24px;
}

.text-heading {
    font-size: 25px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 32px;
    color: #191919;
}
.text-iconText-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 20px;
}
.iconText-container {
    margin-bottom: 0px !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px; 
}
.iconText-container i{
    height: 24px;
    line-height: 24px;
    width: 24px;
    font-size: 24px;
    color: #737373;
}
.iconText-desc {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 24px;
    color: #4C4C4C;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.MM-button {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: 44px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 20px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #6F10A2;
    border: 0px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: none;
    margin: 0 auto;
    margin-top: 4px;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 767px) {
    .mm-container {
        max-width: 100%;
        padding: 43px 20px 29px 20px;
        border: 0px;
        border-radius: 20px 20px 0px 0px;
    }
    .MM-button {
        display: block;
    }
    .close-icon {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
    }
}

PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_2: The Privacy Policy Statement will help you understand how we collect, use and protect your information when you visit our site. We would also like to help you make informed decisions based on accurate and clear information, so please read the following to learn how we may use your personal information.
PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_3: This policy should be read in conjunction with the Terms and Conditions section of this site.
PrivacyPolicy.PILLAR_ONE_PARA: The security of all information associated with our customers is an important concern to us. Therefore, at www.daralarkan.com, we exercise the utmost care in providing secure transmission of your information from your own device to our servers. As known, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your information, Dar Al Arkan cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us, or from our online products or services, and you do so at your risk. Once we receive your transmission, Dar Al Arkan uses industry standard efforts to safeguard the confidentiality of your information. However, “perfect security” does not exist on the Internet as known.
PrivacyPolicy.PILLAR_TWO_PARA: The general rule is that Dar Al Arkan will not disclose any information that you submit to us (especially your personal information), in a manner that it would link to your identity, except, when we have your explicit permission to disclose it, or under special circumstances, such as when we believe in good faith, that the law requires it.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PARA_ONE: By using this site, you agree with the Dar Al Arkan Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use this site, and your continued use of Dar Al Arkan website will mean you accept this Privacy Policy. Information:
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PARA_TWO: The following forms available on the site (www.daralarkan.com) collect your personal data:
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_ONE: Registering emails: Information about Dar Al Arkan, new projects, products and services will be sent periodically through newsletters, updating customers about the latest developments.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_TWO: Contact Us: The information provided by the customer through the contact tab, will not be stored by www.daralarkan.com, and will be used solely to respond to customer inquiries or service requests.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_FOUR: Credit information: Information about the credit policy of Dar Al Arkan will be provided to the customer upon the request, and your credit-information will be kept confidential.

matchmakeronboardingbanner.head_rawhtml:
<style>
body {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
}
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.mm-container {
    max-width: 388px;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 32px 24px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid #D2D2D2;
    background: #FFF;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 48px;
    position: relative;
}

.close-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    background: #F0F0F0;
    position: absolute;
    top: 16px;
    right: 16px;
    padding: 10px;
    display: none;
}
.close-icon i{
    height: 10px;
    line-height: 10px;
    width: 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #000000;
}

.image-container img {
    margin: 0 auto !important;
    display: block;
}

.text-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 24px;
}

.text-heading {
    font-size: 25px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 32px;
    color: #191919;
}
.text-iconText-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 20px;
}
.iconText-container {
    margin-bottom: 0px !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px; 
}
.iconText-container i{
    height: 24px;
    line-height: 24px;
    width: 24px;
    font-size: 24px;
    color: #737373;
}
.iconText-desc {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 24px;
    color: #4C4C4C;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.MM-button {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: 44px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 20px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #6F10A2;
    border: 0px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: none;
    margin: 0 auto;
    margin-top: 4px;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 767px) {
    .mm-container {
        max-width: 100%;
        padding: 43px 20px 29px 20px;
        border: 0px;
        border-radius: 20px 20px 0px 0px;
    }
    .MM-button {
        display: block;
    }
    .close-icon {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
    }
}
</style>
<script src="https://cms.wasalt.com/uploads/matchmaker_onboarding_8f9d1ee01b.js"></script>

Terms.t1: The  Advertising  Terms  are  the  legal  document  that  defines  the  rights  and obligations  between  you  and  Wasalt  Real  Estate  Services  Company,  and should be read along with the Terms of Use, the Privacy Policy and any other terms and conditions posted on the website.
Terms.t2: By entering this page and advertising on the website; as an Advertiser, you acknowledge and agree to be bound by the following:
Terms.t4: To  comply  with  what  is  issued  by  the  general  guide  for  the  controls  of advertising content.
Terms.t5: To abide by what is issued by the competent authorities to regulate ethical and   media   content   in   all   its   informational   media   (traditional   and electronic).
Terms.t6: To abide by the official names of cities, neighborhoods, streets and types of real estate, it is permissible to add customary names
Terms.t7: The Advertisement must contain the following information:
Terms.t8: It  is  stated  as  an  advertisement  (this  can  be  mentioned  in  the description)
Terms.t9: Purpose of the advertisement is specified (sale, rent, etc.)
Terms.t11: The advertiser's name and capacity (owner, authorized)
Terms.t12: The  advertiser's  license  number  is  mentioned  if  he  is  an  office,  a real estate marketer, or holds a freelance document
Terms.t13: Location of the property is mentioned, provided that it contains - at a minimum - the city - the neighborhood - the plot number, if any
Terms.t14: An   effective   means   of   communication   with   the   advertiser   is mentioned
Terms.t15: Real estate data is disclosed as follows:
Terms.t18: - Mortgage or restriction that prevents or limits the disposal or use of real estate
Terms.t19: - Rights and obligations over the property that is not stipulated in the property documents (in the event of a written agreement not mentioned in the deed, for example)
Terms.t21: - Information   that   may   affect   the   property,   whether   by decreasing  its  value  or  affecting  the  target’s  decision  to advertise,  such  as  guarantees  and  their  duration,  matching the Saudi building code, the age of the existing property, and so on.
Terms.t22: - If the Advertisement is a real estate auction, it must - in addition to what is issued by the relevant authorities - include the auction license number, place and conditions, the exact date of its holding, its duration, and the deadline - if any - for submitting to the auction.
Terms.t23: - Description of the property, including its type, age, contents, and any effective description such as the width of the street on which it is located, the facade of the property, and others
Terms.t24: - Limits and lengths of the property
Terms.t26: Any of the following shall be prohibited to be included in the real estate advertisement:
Terms.t27: Violation of Islamic instructions, regulations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, or prevailing customs
Terms.t30: Negative exposure to competitors, private sector establishments, or others
Terms.t31: Phrases or signs that discriminate against anyone
Terms.t32: Pictures, data, website, or perspectives that are misleading or not related to the advertised property
Terms.t33: Logo or name of the Real Estate General Authority or any other government agency without their prior permission
Terms.t34: Publishing fake real estate ads for the purpose of collecting data from recipients or the public or any other purpose is prohibited
Terms.t35: The website shall be entitled to delete any advertisement without stating the reason for the deletion
Terms.t36: The advertiser declares that he is authorized and/or legally authorized to do the advertisement.
Terms.t37: The advertiser agrees to pay the advertising fees to the company (Wasalt Real Estate Services Company), upon executing any sale or rent deals to any client who have reached the advertiser/advertised property by using or visiting the website. PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_1: Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company (hereinafter referred to as “Dar Al Arkan” “us” “we” or “our”) is committed, to respecting your privacy and complying with applicable data protection and privacy laws. You can visit
PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_2: The Privacy Policy Statement will help you understand how we collect, use and protect your information when you visit our site. We would also like to help you make informed decisions based on accurate and clear information, so please read the following to learn how we may use your personal information.
PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_3: This policy should be read in conjunction with the Terms and Conditions section of this site.
PrivacyPolicy.PILLAR_ONE_PARA: The security of all information associated with our customers is an important concern to us. Therefore, at www.daralarkan.com, we exercise the utmost care in providing secure transmission of your information from your own device to our servers. As known, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your information, Dar Al Arkan cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us, or from our online products or services, and you do so at your risk. Once we receive your transmission, Dar Al Arkan uses industry standard efforts to safeguard the confidentiality of your information. However, “perfect security” does not exist on the Internet as known.
PrivacyPolicy.PILLAR_TWO_PARA: The general rule is that Dar Al Arkan will not disclose any information that you submit to us (especially your personal information), in a manner that it would link to your identity, except, when we have your explicit permission to disclose it, or under special circumstances, such as when we believe in good faith, that the law requires it.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PARA_ONE: By using this site, you agree with the Dar Al Arkan Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use this site, and your continued use of Dar Al Arkan website will mean you accept this Privacy Policy. Information:
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PARA_TWO: The following forms available on the site (www.daralarkan.com) collect your personal data:
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_ONE: Registering emails: Information about Dar Al Arkan, new projects, products and services will be sent periodically through newsletters, updating customers about the latest developments.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_TWO: Contact Us: The information provided by the customer through the contact tab, will not be stored by www.daralarkan.com, and will be used solely to respond to customer inquiries or service requests.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_FOUR: Credit information: Information about the credit policy of Dar Al Arkan will be provided to the customer upon the request, and your credit-information will be kept confidential.

matchmakeronboardingbanner.head_rawhtml:
<style>
body {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
}
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.mm-container {
    max-width: 388px;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 32px 24px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid #D2D2D2;
    background: #FFF;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 48px;
    position: relative;
}

.close-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    background: #F0F0F0;
    position: absolute;
    top: 16px;
    right: 16px;
    padding: 10px;
    display: none;
}
.close-icon i{
    height: 10px;
    line-height: 10px;
    width: 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #000000;
}

.image-container img {
    margin: 0 auto !important;
    display: block;
}

.text-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 24px;
}

.text-heading {
    font-size: 25px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 32px;
    color: #191919;
}
.text-iconText-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 20px;
}
.iconText-container {
    margin-bottom: 0px !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px; 
}
.iconText-container i{
    height: 24px;
    line-height: 24px;
    width: 24px;
    font-size: 24px;
    color: #737373;
}
.iconText-desc {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 24px;
    color: #4C4C4C;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.MM-button {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: 44px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 20px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #6F10A2;
    border: 0px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: none;
    margin: 0 auto;
    margin-top: 4px;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 767px) {
    .mm-container {
        max-width: 100%;
        padding: 43px 20px 29px 20px;
        border: 0px;
        border-radius: 20px 20px 0px 0px;
    }
    .MM-button {
        display: block;
    }
    .close-icon {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
    }
}
</style>

PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_1: Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company (hereinafter referred to as “Dar Al Arkan” “us” “we” or “our”) is committed, to respecting your privacy and complying with applicable data protection and privacy laws. You can visit
PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_2: The Privacy Policy Statement will help you understand how we collect, use and protect your information when you visit our site. We would also like to help you make informed decisions based on accurate and clear information, so please read the following to learn how we may use your personal information.
PrivacyPolicy.PRIVACY_PARA_3: This policy should be read in conjunction with the Terms and Conditions section of this site.
PrivacyPolicy.PILLAR_ONE_PARA: The security of all information associated with our customers is an important concern to us. Therefore, at www.daralarkan.com, we exercise the utmost care in providing secure transmission of your information from your own device to our servers. As known, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your information, Dar Al Arkan cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us, or from our online products or services, and you do so at your risk. Once we receive your transmission, Dar Al Arkan uses industry standard efforts to safeguard the confidentiality of your information. However, “perfect security” does not exist on the Internet as known.
PrivacyPolicy.PILLAR_TWO_PARA: The general rule is that Dar Al Arkan will not disclose any information that you submit to us (especially your personal information), in a manner that it would link to your identity, except, when we have your explicit permission to disclose it, or under special circumstances, such as when we believe in good faith, that the law requires it.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PARA_ONE: By using this site, you agree with the Dar Al Arkan Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use this site, and your continued use of Dar Al Arkan website will mean you accept this Privacy Policy. Information:
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PARA_TWO: The following forms available on the site (www.daralarkan.com) collect your personal data:
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_ONE: Registering emails: Information about Dar Al Arkan, new projects, products and services will be sent periodically through newsletters, updating customers about the latest developments.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_TWO: Contact Us: The information provided by the customer through the contact tab, will not be stored by www.daralarkan.com, and will be used solely to respond to customer inquiries or service requests.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_FOUR: Credit information: Information about the credit policy of Dar Al Arkan will be provided to the customer upon the request, and your credit-information will be kept confidential.
PrivacyPolicy.ACCEPTANCE_PILLAR_THREE: Residential Unit Reservation Form: The information provided in this form will be used only to reserve the concerned apartment upon customer request.

matchmakeronboardingbanner.head_rawhtml:
<style>
body {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
}
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.mm-container {
    max-width: 388px;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 32px 24px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid #D2D2D2;
    background: #FFF;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 48px;
    position: relative;
}

.close-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    background: #F0F0F0;
    position: absolute;
    top: 16px;
    right: 16px;
    padding: 10px;
    display: none;
}
.close-icon i{
    height: 10px;
    line-height: 10px;
    width: 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #000000;
}

.image-container img {
    margin: 0 auto !important;
    display: block;
}

.text-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 24px;
}

.text-heading {
    font-size: 25px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 32px;
    color: #191919;
}
.text-iconText-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 20px;
}
.iconText-container {
    margin-bottom: 0px !important;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px; 
}
.iconText-container i{
    height: 24px;
    line-height: 24px;
    width: 24px;
    font-size: 24px;
    color: #737373;
}
.iconText-desc {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 24px;
    color: #4C4C4C;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.MM-button {
    font-family: 'Jost', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', sans-serif;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: 44px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 20px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #6F10A2;
    border: 0px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: none;
    margin: 0 auto;
    margin-top: 4px;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 767px) {
    .mm-container {
        max-width: 100%;
        padding: 43px 20px 29px 20px;
        border: 0px;
        border-radius: 20px 20px 0px 0px;
    }
    .MM-button {
        display: block;
    }
    .close-icon {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
    }
}
</style>

Terms.t1: The  Advertising  Terms  are  the  legal  document  that  defines  the  rights  and obligations  between  you  and  Wasalt  Real  Estate  Services  Company,  and should be read along with the Terms of Use, the Privacy Policy and any other terms and conditions posted on the website.
Terms.t2: By entering this page and advertising on the website; as an Advertiser, you acknowledge and agree to be bound by the following:
Terms.t4: To  comply  with  what  is  issued  by  the  general  guide  for  the  controls  of advertising content.
Terms.t5: To abide by what is issued by the competent authorities to regulate ethical and   media   content   in   all   its   informational   media   (traditional   and electronic).
Terms.t6: To abide by the official names of cities, neighborhoods, streets and types of real estate, it is permissible to add customary names
Terms.t7: The Advertisement must contain the following information:
Terms.t8: It  is  stated  as  an  advertisement  (this  can  be  mentioned  in  the description)
Terms.t9: Purpose of the advertisement is specified (sale, rent, etc.)
Terms.t11: The advertiser's name and capacity (owner, authorized)
Terms.t12: The  advertiser's  license  number  is  mentioned  if  he  is  an  office,  a real estate marketer, or holds a freelance document
Terms.t13: Location of the property is mentioned, provided that it contains - at a minimum - the city - the neighborhood - the plot number, if any
Terms.t14: An   effective   means   of   communication   with   the   advertiser   is mentioned
Terms.t15: Real estate data is disclosed as follows:
Terms.t18: - Mortgage or restriction that prevents or limits the disposal or use of real estate
Terms.t19: - Rights and obligations over the property that is not stipulated in the property documents (in the event of a written agreement not mentioned in the deed, for example)
Terms.t21: - Information   that   may   affect   the   property,   whether   by decreasing  its  value  or  affecting  the  target’s  decision  to advertise,  such  as  guarantees  and  their  duration,  matching the Saudi building code, the age of the existing property, and so on.
Terms.t22: - If the Advertisement is a real estate auction, it must - in addition to what is issued by the relevant authorities - include the auction license number, place and conditions, the exact date of its holding, its duration, and the deadline - if any - for submitting to the auction.
Terms.t23: - Description of the property, including its type, age, contents, and any effective description such as the width of the street on which it is located, the facade of the property, and others
Terms.t24: - Limits and lengths of the property
Terms.t26: Any of the following shall be prohibited to be included in the real estate advertisement:
Terms.t27: Violation of Islamic instructions, regulations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, or prevailing customs
Terms.t30: Negative exposure to competitors, private sector establishments, or others
Terms.t31: Phrases or signs that discriminate against anyone
Terms.t32: Pictures, data, website, or perspectives that are misleading or not related to the advertised property
Terms.t33: Logo or name of the Real Estate General Authority or any other government agency without their prior permission
Terms.t34: Publishing fake real estate ads for the purpose of collecting data from recipients or the public or any other purpose is prohibited
Terms.t35: The website shall be entitled to delete any advertisement without stating the reason for the deletion
Terms.t36: The advertiser declares that he is authorized and/or legally authorized to do the advertisement.
Terms.t37: The advertiser agrees to pay the advertising fees to the company (Wasalt Real Estate Services Company), upon executing any sale or rent deals to any client who have reached the advertiser/advertised property by using or visiting the website. The advertiser also agrees that the customer's statement in this regard is final and he is obligated to pay the advertising fees.
Terms.t38: To avoid anything that causes confusion or mislead the public.
